# Findings and recommendations

Counts refer to unique postings in the 2026-09-21 snapshot, not hires. State and skill counts can overlap. The sample is purposive; 795 postings are automated discovery and 57 have curated source review.

## Findings

### Look beyond one region

304/852 postings (35.7%) name at least one location outside California. New York appears in 225 and Washington in 86. Location counts overlap.

### Graduate evidence needs its own filter

42/852 postings explicitly identify a graduate pathway. The 66 Entry labels also include inferred experience; they do not all establish graduate eligibility.

### Learning priorities differ by direction

SQL appears in 66/79 Data Science postings (83.5%). Kubernetes appears in 66/183 ML Infrastructure postings (36.1%). These are mentions in the sample.

## Two practical recommendations

### Broaden location comparisons

Students and career groups should compare non-California locations before narrowing their exploration. The 304 postings with a non-California location provide a concrete starting set; inspect the actual location and remote restrictions.

### Use separate learning tracks

Career groups can offer a SQL-focused Data Science session and a Kubernetes-focused infrastructure session, based on the 66/79 and 66/183 mention counts. Students can then use Skill lab to choose one project suited to their existing skills; mention frequency alone does not establish a course prerequisite.

## Reproducible skill example

With all filters reset, Python + Machine learning cover 74/816 postings at the fixed 70% target. Adding LLMs adds 93, reaching 167/816. Another 247 postings move closer while staying below target. This is a hypothetical selection, not a measured student outcome.

Source: [frozen dataset](https://ai-career-compass-us-new-grad.zhaotianyu0702.chatgpt.site/downloads/jobs.csv), [locations](https://ai-career-compass-us-new-grad.zhaotianyu0702.chatgpt.site/downloads/job_locations.csv), [skill mentions](https://ai-career-compass-us-new-grad.zhaotianyu0702.chatgpt.site/downloads/job_skills.csv), [source checks](https://ai-career-compass-us-new-grad.zhaotianyu0702.chatgpt.site/downloads/source_coverage.csv).
